notes: The live text assumes a) and b) for the geometric-fibre map and discusses the class u(z) of a cycle fibrewise algebraically equivalent to zero; it asserts membership in an i*-image modulo torsion after replacing S by a nonempty open.
The author retains the reservation « restriction probablement inutile, mais cet énoncé nous suffira pour ce qu’on veut en faire ». The typed probablement replaces cancelled sans doute.

The proof invokes 2), a finite field extension and a trace argument, then a proper smooth relative curve and a correspondence with zero induced H^1(C_sbar) to H^{2n-1}(Y_sbar) map. It invokes 1) for vanishing; neither cited item was imported or proved in this reading.
Section 4 begins a Lefschetz-pencil construction from a smooth projective m-dimensional scheme, adds sur k Alg. clos, and introduces a blow-up, a map to P^1_k and a smooth open restriction.

Literal X_sbar to X_sbar at the top is preserved even though a Y-source might suit the surrounding construction. Product capitals remain ink-driven X/Y alternatives; the argument does not settle them.
The first displayed group has two terminal closes, and the inline i*-group three. Both lack one syntactically expected outer parenthesis; the source omissions are preserved.
A possible rational Q correction over Z in the inline image group is distinguished from a certain clean Z in the class display. Coefficient consequences are not used to decide the ink.
The spelling/spacing Onnsuppose, lesfibres, da point, da classe, de/définit preferred glyphs, Im and Soient is not regularised.
The original and inserted commas around the field qualification are both visible; the exact rhetorical punctuation is not silently regularised.
No website, OCR, text-recognition system, other page, other reader output, or LaTeX compilation was used.

check_events.outcome: Conditional degree calculation only, performed in this run: assuming the usual cohomological cup product and pushforward for the smooth proper curve C, a codimension-n correspondence has degree 2n; an input of degree 1 then has degree 1+2n-2=2n-1 after pushforward along the curve. This matches the displayed target degree. No formal certificate; this does not verify existence, descent, trace, vanishing, or the claims cited as 1) and 2).

brief_feedback: For faint overprints with visible d/s or t/r components but no secure temporal order, explicit structural alternatives are useful. The brief could also specify a preferred inline-safe placement for an isolated nonalphabetic stroke attached to a word, since the required figure macro introduces paragraph breaks. Here the stroke is drawn separately and its exact whole-image location is documented.
